description: Ideation dispatch (T3, D1): the claim `idea → ideating` rides the door (claimed-FROM — a second caller finds the rung gone) and the loop that starts is an ORDINARY loop through the existing loop.start door, running an EXISTING blueprint that declares produces: brief.md. The answer names the ideation loop; the item's arrival at `brief-agreed` happens later on the loop's own terminal event — the engine's existing produces check is the gate (R3), and nothing here polls or watches. The item's loop_slug stays unset: D6 says an item's loop pointer means MATERIALIZATION, never an ideation conversation.
